tested:
Alias: images are imported to disk as .../fortinet/fortinet-FGT-<version>/...
(no "fortigate" path segment - see vendor-images/fortinet/fortigate/ source
tree vs. the flattened /netplex/images/qemu/fortinet/fortinet-FGT-7.2.4.F/
import layout). get_profile() matches on substring/prefix of the resolved
base_image_path, so "fortinet-fortigate" above never matched any real
imported FortiGate image - every FortiGate node silently fell back to
GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (512 MB RAM / 120s boot_timeout instead of the 4096 MB /
240s this platform actually needs), crash-looping under memory pressure and
never reaching RUNNING (same failure shape as the isrv/NX-OS bugs documented
elsewhere in this file). Found live 2026-07-18 chasing a device-audit
timeout for device "fortinet-FGT" (registered image name, also with no
"fortigate" segment) - confirmed by normalizing both the real imported path
and the "fortinet-fortigate" key and finding no substring match either way.

reasons.day0_channel: How netplex hands this device its start-up configuration (a config disk or CD the device reads itself).
